services.name: Tandem Pilot
services.desc: Additional Info: There is NO experience necessary we offer flights from April 1st to October 1st and cater to individuals aged 15 and above, weighing under 260 pounds. (Minors (under 18) must be accompanied by an adult.) Once you arrive at the takeoff point, our skilled tandem instructors will guide you through a seamless pre-flight preparation process. Within a few effortless steps, you'll find yourself airborne, embracing the tranquility of flight while seated comfortably and feeling the wind gently brush through your hair. Please note that the safety of our flights is subject to weather conditions. To ensure the availability of our experienced pilots, we recommend scheduling your flight
